summary: Conduent filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026, disclosing Amendment No. 4 to its October 2021 credit agreement, signed October 14, 2026, with Bank of America as administrative and collateral agent. The amendment briefly extends the maturity of revolving commitments slated to mature October 15, 2026 to October 30, 2026, while other tranches remain unchanged, as the company finalizes a broader refinancing. No pricing, fees, or collateral changes were disclosed. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch for the completed refinancing terms and any liquidity or covenant implications.
